shots.text: Prism Wastes was the last open ground before Solenne. When we left it, there was nowhere left to go back to.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Glass plains under a black sky, shattered into six colours. The army of the Concord falling back toward the city walls.

shots.text: The Lumen Gate, the first of our six walls, fell that night. Behind it, a knight who should have died nine hundred years ago drew her sword.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The outermost wall collapsing. Through the dust: Seraphel, tall, in white-gold plate with six dimming colours, drawing a greatsword of Sunstone glass that glows like dawn.

shots.text: I swore myself to the Sunstone. It is broken, and I am dying with it. Let me spend what is left where it counts.
shots.speaker: seraphel
shots.art_note: Seraphel on the second wall beside the Queen, sword planted. Joins as a hero.
